title: Gate root logging level by build mode
objective: Set Logger.root.level according to Flutter build mode so release builds suppress verbose logs while debug builds keep diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: main.dart imports Flutter foundation build-mode constants as needed
Logger.root.level is conditional on kReleaseMode, kDebugMode, or equivalent build-mode checks
Release builds suppress verbose INFO diagnostics
Debug/profile behavior remains useful for local diagnostics
Existing Supabase and dotenv initialization order is preserved
flutter analyze lib/main.dart reports no new errors
deliverables: Build-mode gated logging setup in lib/main.dart
